title: Traffic
tagline: An ordinary father in Bucharest is forced into a world he never wanted to be par
synopsis: An ordinary father in Bucharest is forced into a world he never wanted to be part of in order to save his son. But the deeper he gets, the more he realizes that the greatest danger comes from where he least expects it. A crime drama about family, sacrifice, and choices from which there is no turning back.
